title: Hematologist visit
what: A doctor who treats blood disorders and problems with how blood is made.
why: For abnormal blood tests: low hemoglobin, or too many or too few white cells or platelets. Also for easy bruising, bleeding, or swollen lymph nodes.
tell_doctor: What bothers you: weakness, bruises, bleeding, weight loss, sweating
All your medicines, especially blood thinners
For women: what your periods are like

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Bring all your recent blood tests. The doctor needs to see the trend.

prepare.title: Other results
prepare.text: Bring ultrasounds and discharge papers, if you have them.

bring: Past test results, discharge papers, and reports
A list of your medicines, or the packs themselves
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms
Your skin and mouth lining are checked
Your lymph nodes and belly are felt
feel: Nothing unpleasant. It is a regular checkup
Feeling the belly and lymph nodes does not hurt
after: A repeat blood test is often ordered
Sometimes more tests are needed. The doctor will explain why
red_flags: Heavy bleeding that will not stop: call emergency services

faq.q: I was referred to a hematologist. Should I be scared?
faq.a: No. Most often the cause is simple, like low iron. The doctor will sort it out.
All the blood tests you have, especially the latest ones.

reminders.text: Hematologist visit tomorrow. Bring all your recent blood tests.
